summary: For most of the 20th century, 'chain of thought' was an everyday English phrase for a person's line of reasoning. In 2022 it was taken up to name a way of prompting large language models to write out intermediate reasoning steps. Today it mostly means the step-by-step reasoning traces that language models generate, including the 'long chain-of-thought' that reasoning models are trained to produce with reinforcement learning. These traces are also studied for efficiency, faithfulness and AI-safety monitoring.

senses.definition: The step-by-step reasoning a model generates, used as output, as training or distillation data, or as an object of faithfulness analysis.

senses.label: Long CoT reasoning
senses.definition: Extended reasoning chains that reasoning models are trained to produce, often via reinforcement learning, to scale computation at test time.

evidence.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong performance on many tasks by producing step-by-step reasoning before giving a final output, often referred to as chain-of-thought reasoning (CoT).
evidence.title: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting

evidence.text: Large language models (LLMs) perform better when they produce step-by-step, "Chain-of-Thought" (CoT) reasoning before answering a question, but it is unclear if the stated reasoning is a faithful explanation of the model's actual reasoning (i.e., its process for answering the question).
evidence.title: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

evidence.text: Recent studies indicate that when faced with explicit biases in prompts, models often omit mentioning these biases in their Chain-of-Thought (CoT) output, revealing that verbalized reasoning can give an incorrect picture of how models arrive at conclusions (unfaithfulness).
evidence.title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning In The Wild Is Not Always Faithful

milestones.title: To CoT or not to CoT? Chain-of-thought helps mainly on math and symbolic reasoning
milestones.why: It argued that CoT's benefits are concentrated in math and symbolic tasks.
milestones.workTitle: To CoT or not to CoT? Chain-of-thought helps mainly on math and symbolic reasoning

evidence.text: Chain-of-thought (CoT) via prompting is the de facto method for eliciting reasoning capabilities from large language models (LLMs).
evidence.title: To CoT or not to CoT? Chain-of-thought helps mainly on math and symbolic reasoning

evidence.text: In addition, code-pretraining greatly benefits strategic reasoning, while advanced reasoning methods such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and Tree-of-Thought (ToT) do not always help.
evidence.title: GTBench: Uncovering the Strategic Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Game-Theoretic Evaluations

milestones.title: OpenAI o1 System Card
milestones.why: CoT became a behaviour instilled by large-scale reinforcement learning rather than something elicited by prompting.

evidence.text: The o1 model series is trained with large-scale reinforcement learning to reason using chain of thought.
evidence.title: OpenAI o1 System Card

evidence.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate enhanced capabilities and reliability by reasoning more, evolving from Chain-of-Thought prompting to product-level solutions like OpenAI o1.
evidence.title: Insight-V: Exploring Long-Chain Visual Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models
